name: Voxel Noise/Checkerboard Application
definition: Adds procedural noise to voxel materials, switching between a sampled noise texture and a deterministic checkerboard pattern based on a cell ID.
summary: Voxel Noise/Checkerboard Application generates a deterministic, binary 3D checkerboard pattern by evaluating the parity of integer grid coordinates, providing sharp, discontinuous transitions distinct from smooth gradient noise methods.
